text:
sam: Heads-up — onboarding 'helion' org needs GPU capacity in ap-south-3. Need quota increases for p5/g5/p4d and some network ceilings. Please advise next steps.

maya: Can you list exact instance counts and timeframe? also which account ID?

sam: Account 789012345678. Target launch next month (MVP). Initial ask: p5.48xlarge x6, g5.48xlarge x12, p4d.24xlarge x2. ENI limit bump to 3000 across the org, Elastic IP quota +20, and increase NAT GW throughput/addressable IPs.

ryan: Tagging previous case pattern — AWS often rejects big one-shot increases. Recommend staged request: start with p5 x3 / g5 x6 / p4d x1 then escalate if approved. Also request On-Demand and Spot quotas separately.

anika: Networking note: the tenant will live in a single VPC with 3 AZ subnets. Current subnets are /24s; we need /22 minimum to avoid IP exhaustion with ENI-heavy instances. Can infra create a preflight subnet plan?

cloudops: Quick checklist I need to submit to AWS: account ID, exact quota codes, region, justification (production, latency-sensitive), current usage, and expected steady-state and peak. Also include a diagram of VPC/subnet sizes.

sam: I'll put together the justification. For steady-state assume 60% of peak (that's why p5 x6 / g5 x12). Peak for internal stress tests may hit full counts for <2 hours.

devops-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-2026-0458 for this request and linked to onboarding playbook. AWS case draft will be attached.

aws-support-bot: FYI — AWS Support pre-check: for p5/p4d requests include SC ticket referencing EC2 Accelerator entitlement. They may require a call.

maya: Cost check — rough monthly GPU runtime estimate if used 50% of steady-state: p5 ~= $40k/mo each (region pricing varies), g5 ~= $10k/mo each, p4d ~= $70k/mo each. This is a non-trivial spend; recommend finance ok before full quota.

ryan: To streamline, I'll submit two service-quotas requests via CLI and open an Enterprise Support case. Command example (fill values before run):

```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-ABC12345 --desired-value 12 --region ap-south-3
```

and for ENIs:

```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-FAE4F1AA --desired-value 3000 --region ap-south-3
```

cloudops: Also attach the VPC/subnet plan and the cost projection. I'll prepare the subnet /22 suggestion and a NAT GW scaling note (we might use NAT Gateway autoscaling + secondary NAT in a different AZ for failover).

anika: +1 on az-failover. Also request to raise ENI per instance and security group rules limit (some of these are separate quota codes).

sam: I'll draft the text for justification. Can one of you review before I submit? want to include fallback plan: use g5dn (cheaper) if p5 capacity delayed.

maya: I'll review the cost appendix. If AWS pushes back, we should request temporary carve-out from our enterprise pool or ask for a pilot increase for 30 days.

ryan: Submitted initial CLI requests and opened Enterprise Support case CASE-2026-4382. AWS response ETA ~48-72h. They requested a short architecture diagram and expected sustained throughput per instance.

devops-bot: INFRA-2026-0458 updated: AWS CASE-2026-4382 attached, initial quota requests created. Please add any missing quota codes in the ticket.

sam: Thanks — I'll upload the diagram and list of quota codes this afternoon. tagging @maya @anika for final review. :pray:

maya: On it. :thumbsup:

aws-support-bot: Reminder: if AWS approves partial quotas, we should coordinate capacity routing in the runtime to fall back to lower-memory variants and enable caching to reduce peak demand.

sam: Agreed. We'll add routing policy to the rollout.

(THREAD END)
